plugins.name: JSON Preview
plugins.description: Tree-style JSON preview in a side panel with syntax colors, error locations, duplicate-key hints, JSON Lines support and format/minify/validate commands. Refreshes while you edit on Luban Notepad 1.0.0-preview.2+; older hosts show a plain-text preview.

versions.release_notes: Fix Format Document and Minify Document when the cursor is near the end of a document that becomes shorter: the host selection is now explicitly reset to the document start.

Initial release. Strict RFC 8259 parser with key order and duplicate keys preserved, tree preview with theme colors, error line/column with source context and caret, duplicate-key hints, JSON Lines detection, and JSON Preview / Format / Minify / Validate commands. Refreshes while you edit on 1.0.0-preview.2+; older hosts render the plain-text fallback and refresh manually.

zh-CN.name: JSON 预览
zh-CN.description: 在右侧面板以树状结构预览 JSON：语法配色、错误行列定位、重复键提示、JSON Lines 自动识别，以及格式化、压缩和校验命令。在 Luban Notepad 1.0.0-preview.2 及以上版本中随编辑自动刷新；旧版本显示纯文本预览。

plugins.name: Markdown Preview
plugins.description: Rendered Markdown preview in a side panel with GFM tables, task lists, quotes and syntax-highlighted code blocks. Refreshes while you edit on Luban Notepad 1.0.0-preview.2+; older hosts show a plain-text preview.

versions.release_notes: Fit wide tables to the 640px preview panel: columns shrink and cells truncate instead of wrapping the box drawing.

Initial release. GFM headings, emphasis, links, images, lists, task lists, quotes, fenced and indented code, tables and rules. Code blocks use the host syntax theme via luban.syntax.highlight. The preview follows edits on 1.0.0-preview.2+; older hosts render the plain-text fallback and refresh manually.

zh-CN.name: Markdown 预览
zh-CN.description: 在右侧面板渲染 Markdown：支持 GFM 表格、任务列表、引用和语法高亮代码块。在 Luban Notepad 1.0.0-preview.2 及以上版本中随编辑自动刷新；旧版本显示纯文本预览。
